commit.message:
Converge the dihydrate HSE06 run (new folder F2, claims K19b/K20b)

The agents' run stopped after 12 exact-exchange cycles. The same input,
re-run in a fresh container, reproduces those 12 cycles digit for digit
and converges after 41 ('!!' energy, dexx 2e-7 Ry). Result: gap 2.14 eV,
hole window 2.31 eV (was 2.43), electron window 1.40 eV (was 1.42), both
edges still in one spin channel. Caveat 7, README corrections, the blog
table and the web chart now use the converged values; 58 checks pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Compare against Middlemiss et al. (2008) after reading the full text

Their Fig. 3a (35% exact exchange, CRYSTAL03) already shows both band
edges in the same spin channel, with windows of about 3.1 and 1.5 eV,
unremarked in the text. Record the verified Table 3 values, the
independent agreement with this ledger (gap 2.1 vs 2.09 eV), and narrow
the novelty claim to pointing out, quantifying and stress-testing it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Cite Middlemiss, Lawton & Wilson (2008); narrow the novelty claim

The agents' literature search missed this hybrid-DFT study of the same
crystal. Until its full text is checked, the same-spin band edges are not
claimed as new; the claim is the spin-window widths, the LCM
identification and the robustness checks.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Cite the 2008 calculation on KV[Cr(CN)6] and the 2025 cyanide LCM paper

Kabalan et al. (Chem. Phys. 352, 85 (2008)) computed an insulating
zero-moment state (LDA for the crystal; B3LYP only for molecular models)
but reported no band-edge spins, per-spin gaps or spin splitting. State
exactly what this ledger adds (caveat 11, README, blog, web page), and
note that Guo et al. (arXiv:2502.18136) found their Mn(CN)2/Co(CN)2 order
below room temperature and called for a room-temperature LCM.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Address an outside review; add the ordering and hull raw outputs; correct the hull distance

Review fixes
- zero net moment: a whole-number spin moment, exact only for the ideal
  collinear crystal at 0 K; spin-orbit/orbital moments and finite-T
  compensation not established (definitions, caveats 1 and 5, all prose)
- inequivalent sublattices, not necessarily different elements
- 420 K raw and 490 K calibrated are two estimates (text and figure)
- 1999 sample kept apart from the ideal crystal (hydrated powder,
  0.125 muB/f.u., 365 K after heating, gap and windows unmeasured)
- qe_parse: hybrid runs count as converged only when the exact-exchange
  loop converged ('!!'); the dihydrate HSE06 run is now flagged
- tools/build_runs_index.py regenerates ledger/runs.csv (875 inputs);
  'converged' is n/a for nscf/bands and requires geometry convergence for
  relaxations

New raw data
- runs/J_cation_order_cluster_expansion_raw: all four rounds of the
  cation-ordering study (v4 feeds the cluster expansion)
- runs/K_hull_competing_phases_raw: the 0 K hull runs
- tools/crosscheck_raw.py: 183/184 recorded ordering energies match their
  raw outputs (one saved output is truncated); all 36 hull energies match

Correction
- YBaMnFeO5 is +13.7 meV/atom above the hull, not +2.6: the agents' value
  is reproduced with the 28 competitors finished at the time (Y24), but two
  phases that finished later (BaFe2O4, Ba6Y2Fe4O15) lower the hull (Y24b)
- caveats for two partly relaxed geometries (water-filled vacancy cell;
  two cation arrangements that hit the step limit)

Computational ledger for YBaMnFeO5 and KV[Cr(CN)6]

Raw Quantum ESPRESSO inputs and outputs, structures, analysis data and
scripts behind the blog post "Two magnets that add up to zero", plus
a claim-by-claim checker (tools/verify.py), Level-2 re-run scripts and
an independent re-run in a fresh cloud container.
